title: My Landlord Had ONE Rule… I Broke It on Night One
hook: My landlord had ONE rule: never unplug the hallway camera
story: My landlord gave me one rule when I moved in: never unplug the old camera in the hallway. I thought he was a creep, so on my first night, I unplugged it. The next morning, there was a sticky note on my door, in handwriting I didn't recognize. It said: "Thank you." I called my landlord, shaking. He went quiet, then asked me a question that made my stomach drop. "Did you lock your door from the inside last night?" I said, of course. He said, "The tenant before you said that too." Turns out the camera wasn't watching me. It was watching the hallway closet. The one that's been painted shut for twenty years. That night, I plugged the camera back in and watched the feed from my bed. At 3:12 a.m., the closet door opened… from the inside. Whatever stepped out looked straight into the lens. And slowly, it reached up… and unplugged it. So if your landlord ever gives you one rule… follow it.
description:
Some rules exist for a reason. 🔦
